window.note: window = decimated samples [b-188, b-38) with b = floor(tresp/4); i.e. 1 kHz time [4b-752, 4b-152) ms; 4b is 0-3 ms before the response, so the window ends 152-155 ms before the response and spans about -755 to -152 ms

rule: Among grid windows with B >= 100 ms and pooled retention >= 80 percent, choose the largest L; ties are broken by the largest B.
canonical_normalization: per-participant z-score over the participant's retained trials (target participant's unlabeled batch used; labels never used)

variants.canonical: per-participant z-score over the participant's retained trials (target participant's unlabeled batch used; labels never used)
variants.all_trials_batch: per-participant z-score over ALL valid trials of the participant, including excluded fast trials (normalization of the first submitted manuscript's Table 4)
variants.training_only_pooled: no target-participant data used: every feature standardized with the mean/SD of the pooled training participants' raw features
variants.separate_calibration_run: held-out participant's run r standardized with statistics of the participant's OTHER run (unlabeled calibration session); training participants as canonical
variants.causal_running: each trial standardized with the mean/SD of the participant's earlier retained trials in the same run (>= 20 earlier trials required; trials with fewer are dropped from training and testing)
variants.rt_linear_transductive: canonical features residualized on the participant's own z(ln RT) (needs completed RTs of the target participant)
variants.rt_linear_training_only: residualization coefficients estimated on training participants only and applied to the held-out participant (no target RT regression)
variants.rt_flex_training_only: as above with the 5-df natural-spline RT basis

rt_regression: linear: z(ln RT) within participant; flexible: 5-df natural cubic spline of the within-participant rank of ln RT; residualization within participant with intercept; re-standardized
rt_deciles: within-participant rank deciles of ln RT; terciles analogous
